HFSS Eigenmode and the Q3D C/G preparation can also start from a `GeometryPlan` snapshot; Q2D starts from a `Q2dSpec` of explicit rectangles and conductor groups. | a portable handoff that an AEDT run reads; from a finished run the detached results (`ResolvedRun`, `EprResult`); from a preparation-only run, which never invokes the solver, the `PreparedModel`. | `python -m scgsim.aedt.run` executes the handoff; notebooks read a finished run through `resolve_results`, a preparation-only run through `resolve_prepared_model`, and plot with the plot helpers. |
| `aedt/specs` | The AEDT request records for HFSS, Q3D and Q2D runs, with their payload decoders. | a caller's request values, or a stored request payload. | immutable spec records and their canonical payloads (`parse_aedt_spec` picks the family); this file re-exports the lumped terminal records and `HfssDrivenGeometrySpec`. | `preparation` writes the specs into a handoff, `runtime` executes them and `results` checks a run's receipt against them. |
| `aedt/preparation` | Write one portable AEDT handoff from a request spec or a geometry plan, without opening AEDT. | an AEDT request spec (`specs`) for `prepare_handoff`, or a `GeometryPlan` snapshot from `scgsim.geometry` for the HFSS and Q3D geometry adapters and `EigenmodeSim`. | a handoff folder (`HandoffPlan`) holding the request payload, the prepared planar geometry and the hash cohort that binds its files, plus the native object names (`planar_source`) every later stage gives the same source entity. | `runtime` executes the handoff; `runtime/native` and `epr` name native objects through `planar_source`; `results` checks a run against the cohort. |
| `aedt/runtime` | Execute one prepared handoff inside AEDT and record what it produced. | a handoff folder from `preparation`, started by `python -m scgsim.aedt.run` or a native batch (`scgsim.aedt.batch`). | the run folder: the saved AEDT project, the native exports and the run receipt, which binds them to the handoff and the runtime source; also the Q3D stop and save requests a notebook sends to a running solve (`control`). | `results` reads the receipt and the run folder offline. |
| `aedt/runtime/families` | Build, solve and export one request family (HFSS, Q3D, Q2D) in the AEDT application the transaction owns. | the validated request spec and prepared geometry, with the open AEDT application, from `runtime.transaction`; `epr.native_workflow` and `epr.adaptive` call the HFSS Eigenmode setup, export and history steps. | the solved native design, its exported files in the run folder and the native evidence the receipt records. | `runtime.transaction` writes the receipt; `results` reads the exported files. |
| `aedt/runtime/native` | The PyAEDT calls that create, assign and read back native objects, below the request families. | PyAEDT application objects and the prepared records, from `runtime/families`, `epr` and `runtime.transaction`. | native bodies, sheets, boundaries, setups and the solver resources around one solve, each with the read-back evidence that checks it. | `runtime/families` and `epr` put that evidence into their results; `scgsim.visualization` reads `compatibility` for the pinned PyAEDT transport. |
| `aedt/results` | Read a finished or preparation-only AEDT run offline, and hold the receipt checks its writers share. | a run folder with its receipt (written by `runtime`) and the handoff it ran (written by `preparation`). | `ResolvedRun`, `PreparedModel` and `EprResult`, read only from a current receipt; also the receipt schema and runtime-source record (`provenance`, `runtime_inventory`), the contained-path check and the matrix export parsers that `preparation` and `runtime` call while writing. | notebooks through the `scgsim.aedt` facade, `presentation`, `scgsim.aedt.batch_stages` and the AEDT loaders of `scgsim.visualization`. |
| `aedt/results/convergence` | Parse the native convergence reports of HFSS, Q3D and Q2D runs. | the convergence report files a run exported into its run folder. | strict per-pass convergence records, refused when a report does not match its family's format. | `runtime/families` binds them into the result the receipt records; the `results` readback reads them again offline. |
| `aedt/epr` | Energy participation ratio (EPR) analysis of an HFSS Eigenmode solution, at each stage it passes through. | an EPR request (`specs.epr`) with the prepared planar geometry from `preparation`; in AEDT, the solved design from `runtime/families`; offline, the stored result rows of a run. | the analysis-sheet and inset plan computed when a run starts, the field expressions, caches and integrals evaluated in AEDT, and the detached `EprResult` with its offline reanalysis. | `runtime.transaction` runs the in-AEDT part; `results.epr` resolves the result; `presentation` plots it. |
| `aedt/presentation` | Show a resolved AEDT run or an EPR result in a notebook. | a `ResolvedRun` or `EprResult` from `results`, or a recorded benchmark. | notebook tables and Plotly figures; nothing is written back to the run. | the notebook reader; the `ResolvedRun` display methods and the `scgsim.aedt` plot helpers call it. |
